adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` the reschedule-merge path still deletes only a single old calendar reference: `const oldCalendarEvent = booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes("_calendar"));` (in the `if (newBookingId)` block). Earlier in the diff, calendar references were refactored to support multiple `_calendar` references via `filter(...)` and looped processing, so keeping `find(...)` here will only act on the first calendar reference and can leave other old calendar events undeleted for multi-calendar (e.g., collective/team) bookings.
